scope: One authorized owned USB phone; one allowlisted optional app; Android user 0 only
verification: Each read re-checks USB authorization and build identity, then requires the exact dumpsys user-0 enabled code to agree with pm list -e and -d. Raw dumpsys independently showed enabled=0 before and after.
privacy: Serial, build fingerprint, address and private content excluded
limitation: One controlled reversible app-state loop. App data is preserved by disable-user. No universal compatibility claim.
